---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "feat: <short summary>"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the use case, not the solution.
Why does the current behavior fall short?

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. Be concrete: which module, which endpoint, which
config knob. Sketch the surface area if it is a new API.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed and why you ruled them out. "None" is acceptable but
think about it first.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art in similar projects, screenshots if relevant.
Note any security or secret-handling implications — k-fin is read-only against
Comdirect by design and that boundary will not move.
